target_customer: Companies running AI agents in production on frontier model APIs and paying large inference bills
problem: Teams that built agents on frontier APIs pay high per-call costs and cannot safely swap in cheaper models. Duet post-trains small open models on the customer's own traffic and proves them against expert graders before replacing the API.
business_model: Services and usage-based model replacement, priced against API savings (pricing not public)
product_category: Model post-training and distillation infrastructure for AI agents

technical_complexity.rationale: Requires post-training pipelines, grader construction with customer experts and gated rollout, with parity often holding only on the trained distribution per commentary found.

defensibility.rationale: Several startups and labs sell the same post-train and replace workflow. The only possible lock-in is customer traffic data and grader sets.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Too early to know; the company is in its first batch.

market_need_then: Sources from 2026 describe a trend of teams logging frontier API traffic and training smaller task models to cut inference costs, with vendor-claimed savings of several times. Evidence of demand is mostly vendor-authored.

branding.domain_note: Uses duetmachines.com; no acquisition story found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Short and metaphorical: turn your company into a model factory

brand_strength.rationale: Branding search returned only unrelated Duet brands such as Duet3D. No press on this company's brand.

outcome_analysis: Duet Machines is an Active company in its first YC batch, Summer 2026, so there is no outcome yet. The founders are repeat founders from Dialogus with Google and Meta backgrounds. The wedge is crowded with other post-training services, including another S26 company, so execution and proof of savings will decide it.
notes: No funding found for Duet Machines. Searches returned only data on Dialogus (CB Insights shows $500K total with Pioneer Fund and YC; Dealroom shows $125k seed) and these are not Duet rounds. The duetmachines.com fetch returned only a tagline. Outcome search found nothing about the company.
